hints.title: Balanced Segment Structure
hints.text: A balanced substring consists of some number of contiguous zeros immediately followed by an equal number of contiguous ones.

hints.title: Run-Length Tracking
hints.text: Track consecutive counts of zeros and consecutive counts of ones across the string.

hints.title: Balanced Pair Capacity
hints.text: Whenever transitioning from zeros to ones, the maximum balanced length is 2 * min(zeros_count, ones_count).

hints.title: Consecutive Run Counting Implementation

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Single pass tracking contiguous zeros and ones.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substring windows takes O(n^3) or O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Counts adjacent runs of 0s and 1s in a single linear pass.
